Ethan — quick Ops note on routing and Greenhouse steps (copying the checklist I use):

Greenhouse offer routing (standard for IC hires):
- Create Offer in GH -> select template Redwood_Generic_Offer_v3.docx
- Populate: base salary, target bonus %, equity grant, start date, relocation, signing bonus field (if any)
- Attach: Comp_Band_Grid_2027.xlsx, Req approval memo (HC-2027-432)
- Route approvals: Recruiter (you) -> Hiring Manager (Laura) -> People Ops (people-ops@redwood.ai) -> Compensation (comp@redwood.ai) -> Legal (legal@redwood.ai) -> Finance (payroll@redwood.ai)

Thresholds and notes:
- If base salary > $160,000 OR total cash (base + guaranteed sign-on) > $180,000, escalate to Compensation Committee.
- Equity > 0.5% requires exec sign-off.
- Signing bonus > $15,000 requires Finance pre-approval (payroll timing).

Files to attach in GH: Comp_Band_Grid_2027.xlsx (attached here), Redwood_Generic_Offer_v3.docx (use template), Req notes (already attached).

I'll pre-seed People Ops approval to speed things up since HC is already validated. If Comp needs to review amounts, it usually takes 24 business hours. Legal review tends to be same-day for standard offers.

Marissa Cole
Recruiter Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments included: Comp_Band_Grid_2027.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks for the draft routing — a couple of corrections from Comp: we should use these thresholds (we tightened them this quarter):

- Compensation Committee trigger: base salary > $170,000 OR total cash > $190,000 (we raised the floor).
- Equity: 0.5% threshold still stands for exec sign-off.
- For candidate-level sign-on: manager discretionary up to $10,000; anything above $10,000 requires Comp + Finance pre-approval.

For Elena specifically, the numbers you listed (base $170k, 12% bonus, 0.35% equity) are at the top of CB4. Given HC-2027-432 is approved and the manager confirmed, I am comfortable with base = $170,000 and the $10k sign-on (manager discretionary) if you want to include it. No Comp Committee required per current numbers.

I'll add a short comment in GH on the comp approver step: "Karthik Iyer - comp reviewed; CB4; base $170k; equity 0.35%; sign-on $10k manager-approved."

Karthik Iyer
